title: UpsertAuthorInput
description: The payload the brain/CLI or admin panel submits to POST /authors (scope admin:write) to create or update a managed author, keyed on handle (upsert). This file is the single cross-layer contract for the author write shape; it mirrors the Go authorInput. Server-owned/read-only fields (deleted, created_at, updated_at) are computed server-side and are not accepted here. sources is optional and TRISTATE: omit it to leave the attached-source join untouched, or send an array (possibly empty) to replace the set.

handle.description: The stable author id/slug; the upsert key. The only required field.

name.description: Display name / byline. Optional; defaults to empty server-side.

bio.description: Short bio shown on cards. Optional.

avatar.description: Avatar/photo media URL (e.g. a /media path). Optional.

gender.description: Optional grammatical-gender hint used for voice consistency.

about.description: Long public about-page text (newlines preserved as paragraphs). Optional.

style.description: Private voice/writing prompt. Served to the panel but NEVER rendered publicly. Optional.

topics.description: Curated public-profile beats/topics. Optional; replaces the set when present.

sources.description: Attached source-outlet slugs. Optional and tristate: omit to leave the join untouched; an array (even empty) replaces the attached-source set.
